definitions: The northernmost point on the Earth, diametrically opposite the South Pole, with a latitude of 90° North.
The northern end of the axis of rotation of the Earth.
The magnetic North Pole, a wandering point on the Earth's surface where the Earth's magnetic field lines are directed vertically downwards.
examples: Santa Claus is traditionally said to live at the North Pole.
Explorers have long sought to reach the North Pole.
The magnetic North Pole is constantly shifting.
